title: Abaddon's Common Relics

html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 4 of Abaddon's Common Sweatband Relics from within The Embercore Path and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 5 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 4 of Abaddon's Common Sweatband Relics from within The Embercore Path and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Krelgor's Used Relics: We Buy Your Relics!
WANTED: 4 of Abaddon's Common Sweatband Relics. Willing to pay King's Coin for Relics at a great rate! Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Abaddon's Common Relics ×4

Client level range: 40–100
